questions.q:
In the park I happened to meet two of my father's friend who had known him for several years.

[СРО 13/12/2019 S3]
o: two of my father's friends
two of my fathers friend
two friends of my fathers
questions.s:
The correct answer is: two of my father's friends

  • The word "friend" is incorrect because "two" indicates a plural form, so it should be "friends."

  • The possessive "father's" is correct as it shows that the friends belong to the father.

Corrected Sentence: In the park, I happened to meet two of my father's friends who had known him for several years.

questions.q:
Spot the error in the given sentence and select the correct sentence from the options given.

Ten miles are a long distance to walk every morning.
o: Ten miles is a long distance to walk every morning.
Ten miles are long distances to walk every morning.
Ten mile is a long distance to walk every morning.
Ten miles is long distances to walk every morning.
questions.s:
When a subject expresses a unit of measurement, distance, time, or money, it is treated as a single, collective entity and takes a singular verb. Even though the noun "miles" is plural, the entire phrase "Ten miles" represents one single measure of distance.

So, option (b) is eliminated as it uses the plural verb "are".

Option a): This is correct. The subject "Ten miles" is treated as a single unit, and the singular verb "is" correctly agrees with it.

Option c): This is incorrect. The number "Ten" requires the plural noun "miles".

Option d): This is incorrect. While the verb "is" is correct, the plural complement "distances" clashes with the idea of "ten miles" being a single entity.

Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.
